checks.quote: Now that you have an API key, pass it on any API call as a header: Authorization: Bearer plainApiKey_xxx
Plain MCP uses OAuth to allow your MCP server connection to share the same context as your normal web app user.
Every plan starts with a free 7-day trial, and the trial doesn’t need a credit card.
Plain is a customer support platform for B2B and technical SaaS companies, built entirely on its own public GraphQL API so there is full parity between what the product UI and the API can do.
The Plain MCP server at https://mcp.plain.com/mcp lets tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor work with your support data directly.
